description: Step 7: Get a phone number. Order a phone number for the business ($1.99 a month, billed daily from the wallet). Needs $2 of paid credit available (free trial credit covers calls only); no human sign-in. On 402 funding_required call ringkit_top_up, ask the human to pay the checkoutUrl, then retry. Identical requests are deduplicated for 24 hours; use a new idempotencyKey only to deliberately repeat the action.

businessId.description: Defaults to the business of the API key in the Authorization header.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Retries of the same call should reuse it (the stored result comes back); a new value deliberately repeats an identical call. The MCP POST's Idempotency-Key header takes precedence.

name: ringkit_provision_number
title: Get a phone number
